name: Attribute-Based Price decision-table adjustment (contracted vs catalog)
expected: V21 ListContainer / AttributeBasedPrice branch, gated AttributePricingFilter = ItemContractAttributePasId IsNotNull AND ItemPricingSource!='LastTransaction' AND DerivedPricingAttribute IsNotNull AND =false, consults LookUpApiName=Attribute_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table with IsContractEnabled=true and applies the CONTRACTED attribute adjustment to NetUnitPrice (distinct from the catalog AttributeDiscountEntries / ListContainer7 path).
actual: The contracted branch could NOT be exercised. ItemContractAttributePasId is a platform-managed, transient, customMappingAllowed=false contracted-pricing context attribute (inheritedFrom std SalesTransactionItem/ContractAttributePasId) - it is hydrated only when the line's Contract resolves to a contracted ATTRIBUTE PriceAdjustmentSchedule; it cannot be hand-set on a QLI. Org has ZERO contracted-attribute pricing: 0 QuoteLineItem and 0 OrderItem have PricingContractId set; only 1 ContractItemPrice exists (CIP-0000000001, a price/discount 10%-off entry for PIA-BoKS 01tWC00000DD1btYAD, NOT attribute-based); the only Attribute-type PriceAdjustmentSchedule is the CATALOG one 84Xa50000010nWQEAY (=AttributePASIdConstant). Empirical smoke test: built Quote 0Q0WC000003FaZJ0A0 with L1 (AAMP, PricingContractId=800WC00000SFn6jYAD + {RAA,OnPrem,Non-Production}) and L2 (same attrs, no contract); Force-reprice place isSuccess=true -> BOTH lines NetUnitPrice=1575=list(3150)x0.5 IDENTICALLY (Source_List_Price__c=Base_Price__c=1575, Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=false, no QuoteLinePriceAdjustment rows). Setting PricingContractId to a Contract with no contracted-attribute PAS did not hydrate ItemContractAttributePasId and did not route through the D-06 contracted branch - the result is the catalog AttributeDiscountEntries path, the same as L2.
evidence: Active V21 proc retrieve Data/pricing-v21-validation/d06_proc/unpackaged/expressionSetDefinition/Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure.expressionSetDefinition (label 'Rev Mgmt Default Pricing V21', status Active; AttributePricingFilter gating at active-block rel-line ~1149 = ItemContractAttributePasId IsNotNull...; AttributeBasedPrice LookUpApiName=Attribute_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table, IsContractEnabled=true). Context: Data/sc3473/a02_ctx/.../SalesTransactionContextExt_v2.contextDefinition-meta.xml line 22896 ContractAttributePasId customMappingAllowed=false transient=true. Org state: QLI/OI PricingContractId count=0; ContractItemPrice count=1 (CIP-0000000001, ItemId=01tWC00000DD1btYAD, DiscountValue=10); PriceAdjustmentSchedule Attribute count=1 (84Xa50000010nWQEAY). Fixture quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FaZJ0A0/view ; L1(contracted)=0QLWC000003kk694AA L2(catalog)=0QLWC000003kk6A4AQ both Net=1575; reprice place isSuccess=true errorResponse=[].
proposedFix: Not a defect to fix in V21. To MAKE D-06 testable, configure contracted-attribute pricing in FortraUAT: create a Contract whose lines carry an Attribute-type PriceAdjustmentSchedule (so RLM Contract Pricing hydrates ItemContractAttributePasId on the line), set the QLI PricingContractId to that Contract, then Force-reprice and confirm the contracted AttributeBasedPrice (ListContainer) branch fires with a contracted-rate net != the catalog rate. This is org-config setup beyond a test-data fixture and was explicitly NOT applied (validation only).
notes: Two parallel attribute-pricing branches confirmed in active V21: (a) D-06 CONTRACTED = ListContainer / AttributePricingFilter (ItemContractAttributePasId IsNotNull...) -> AttributeBasedPrice (IsContractEnabled=true); (b) D-03 CATALOG = ListContainer7 / AttributePricingFilter8 ((IsContracted IsNull OR =false) AND ItemPricingSource!=LastTransaction) -> AttributeDiscountEntries. Both consult the same Attribute_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table (LookUpId 0lDa50000007BEuEAM, schedule 84Xa50000010nWQEAY). D-03 verified the catalog branch is live; D-06's contracted branch is structurally present but DORMANT org-wide because no contracted-attribute pricing data exists. Preflight FAILS on the scenario-required gating field (ItemContractAttributePasId cannot be made non-null with available data/config), so per the brief this is BLOCKED (data/route unverified), NOT FAIL and NOT a procedure defect. The 1575=3150x0.5 catalog result is correct and not a $0 headless artifact (Source_List_Price__c hydrated, isSuccess=true). New fixture scripts/apex/setupContractAttrPriceTestData.compact.apex.
verdict_reason: The D-06 contracted AttributeBasedPrice branch is gated on ItemContractAttributePasId IsNotNull, a transient platform-managed field that requires a Contract-linked attribute PriceAdjustmentSchedule which does not exist in FortraUAT (0 contracted lines, only a catalog Attribute PAS); the branch cannot be exercised via a test-data fixture, so the scenario is BLOCKED with preflight failing on the required gating field, not a reportable defect.
